verdict.rationale: Unleash's impact metrics can query external metrics at read time from your own Prometheus or VictoriaMetrics instance, so the data stays in your system. However, these metrics are documented for gating rollouts (error rates, latency thresholds), not for analyzing experiments, and the variants/A/B docs show no metric definition tied to experiment results. missing for 10: defining experiment metrics from warehouse tables, defining metrics from ingested product events, linking metrics to variant/A/B experiment analysis, any independent or hands-on corroboration.
